actual: C-012-RL1 immutable bundle build on the frozen full universe first exceeded the approved 1200-second qlib_month_spool budget because _read_qlib_stock_rows used scalar Python materialization. After removing that bottleneck, the same frozen build exposed independent fail-closed contract defects: repeated scalar security/industry resolution, loss of provider-absence all-NA price rows, an incorrect moneyflow requirement when no price observation exists, and comparison of the published 131-L2 authority against the unprojected 134-code taxonomy. The build must preserve source identity, causal state, provider absence and the approved 31/131 domain without changing any model, seed, selection or validation contract.
closure_requirements: Complete the frozen full-universe immutable bundle build within the approved 1200-second and 4-GiB build budget without changing output semantics.
Preserve all-NA Qlib rows as explicit provider-absence evidence while rejecting partial non-finite or infinite source rows.
Keep price, circ_mv, moneyflow and industry availability as independent causal evidence and never synthesize a neutral/default observation.
Use the frozen C-013 published 31-L1/131-L2 projection authority rather than the unprojected 134-code taxonomy.
Run the routed HMM verification plans and a fresh-process frozen build readback.
Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description: Repair the frozen full-universe C-012-RL1 immutable bundle builder without weakening its causal or fail-closed contracts: vectorize Qlib materialization, index immutable security and industry authorities, preserve provider-absence NA evidence, keep independent feature-source availability, and close the published 31/131 C-013 projection authority. The fix must not change HMM parameters, seeds, D4/D5/D6 acceptance, hard semantic authority, model selection or READY semantics.
expected: On the same frozen dataset and mapping authority, the immutable bundle build completes within 1200 seconds and 4 GiB, emits deterministic canonical output for the approved 31-L1/131-L2 domain, preserves all-NA provider absence without treating Inf or partially non-finite rows as missing, and advances price, circ_mv, moneyflow and industry evidence only from their own causal observations. No default sector, neutral value, hidden source substitution, model-contract change, seed selection or READY artifact is permitted.
non_goals: Do not start, stop, or restart any user backend without explicit per-target approval.
